parts.prompt: Give one task performed by an operating system and explain why it is needed.
Name one application a student could use to make a poster.
What is one advantage of keeping a compressed archive of a finished project?
How can version history help a team after someone accidentally removes a paragraph?
A student rewrites an online explanation in their own words. State two things they should do to avoid plagiarism.
Compare the usual range of Bluetooth and Wi-Fi inside a school.
Why is sending a password over an encrypted connection safer than sending it as readable text?
A student uploads a group photo to a public page. Give two privacy checks to make first.
Explain why changing a post from public to friends-only may not remove every trace of an earlier public version.
A column contains 4, 7, 7 and 10. A rule highlights duplicate values. Which value is highlighted?
What happens to the values if that duplicate rule is removed?
A model estimates library seats needed from the number of classes and seats per class. Identify the two inputs.
If the model predicts 96 seats but only 90 are available, how many more seats are needed?
The model assumes every student attends, but some are absent. Explain how this assumption may affect the decision to hire extra chairs.
Name the data type of True, 2.75 and '2.75'.
What do * and ** mean in Python?
Why is a saved script useful when the same several Python instructions must be run again tomorrow?
Give the output of each independent statement: print(15 / 3), print(15 // 4), print(2 ** 4).
A translation app improves after learning from many examples. Explain two features that make this an AI application.
Give one possible benefit and one risk of an AI assistant suggesting replies to personal messages.
Why might a delivery company simulate an automated route before sending a real vehicle?

questions.title: Field trip travel model
questions.intro: A class models the minutes needed for a field trip. Empty result cells will contain formulas.

parts.prompt: Classify A2 'Outbound bus', B2 '55', and the formula in B8 as label, data or calculation.
Write a SUM formula for travel time in B4.
Write a SUM formula for activity time in B7.
Write a formula in B8 for the total outing time using B4 and B7.
What total outing time does the model show?
A traffic delay adds 25 minutes to the outbound bus. State the revised total and increase.
A rule highlights B8 when total time exceeds 210 minutes. Give the comparison and state whether exactly 210 is highlighted.

Route A takes 75 minutes of travel and 130 minutes of activities. Route B takes 60 minutes of travel and 140 minutes of activities. The group must finish within 200 minutes. Recommend one using both totals and the limit.

questions.title: Following and designing flowcharts
questions.diagram: Start → Input length, width → P → Output Q → Stop

parts.prompt: State the purpose of an arrow, a process rectangle and a connector in a flowchart.
In the steps shown, replace P with a calculation and Q with the value to display.
Trace the steps for length = 8 and width = 3. State area and output.
Build a flowchart that inputs the number of posters and the cost per poster, calculates total printing cost, outputs it, and ends.
This should find the perimeter of a square. Rewrite lines 2 and 3 to fix three errors.
parts.starter:
1 side = int(input('Side: '))
2 perimeter = side * 2
3 print('Area:', perimeter + 1)

parts.prompt: Write a program that inputs the number of full water bottles and litres in each as whole numbers. A tank starts with 200 litres. Calculate and print litres left after filling the bottles. Assume the used water is at most 200 litres.
Give a valid pair of inputs and the expected litres left.

questions.title: AI for museum exhibits
questions.intro: A museum trials an AI guide that recognises exhibits. It is also considering an automated display stand.

parts.prompt: Name one type of data a camera-based exhibit guide receives.
Explain how image recognition can distinguish a sculpture from a painting.
A fixed audio guide plays exhibit 1 then 2. How could an AI guide behave differently?
The guide camera may record other visitors. Give one concern and one action that addresses it.
A trial confuses two similar sculptures. Should the museum remove all human help desks? Give a benefit, limitation, mitigation and recommendation.
Why simulate an automated display stand's movement before allowing visitors near it?
